faq.q: Can I submit IPS work as my own assessed assignment?
faq.a: IPS offers research coaching, editorial support, data services and permitted professional work. Assessed submissions must remain your own and follow institutional rules.

faq.q: When do I need to pay?
faq.a: An IPS manager reviews the request and issues a written quotation. Online payment integration is pending and no payments are collected through this website yet.
Choose a verified written channel such as email, your IPS workspace or an available messaging service. IPS does not call customers.
Use your confidential IPS workspace for your requests, written replies, reviewed files, project milestones and support.
IPS checks specialist applications and suitability before assigning eligible, authorized work. Communication stays centrally managed.
Review the permitted revisions and delivery terms in the written project scope. Submit and follow change requests in your workspace.

about.headline: We Exist to Eliminate Barriers
about.p1: We believe every student, researcher, and professional worldwide deserves access to quality academic and professional services they can afford and trust.
about.p2: IPS centrally coordinates confidential research-method coaching, academic editing, data support and independent professional consulting. Academic submissions must comply with institutional rules.
